name: Star Trek
source: MTGJSON 5.3.0+20261102 card list https://mtgjson.com/api/v5/TRK.json (2026-11-02), collated from the Forge edition file's booster slots for Star Trek (5 Common, 1 Common-Stardates, 1 Common-Klingon, 3 Uncommon, 1 RareMythic, 1 Wildcard, 1 foil Wildcard, 1 Land): each slot's replacement odds are folded into one weighted sheet per slot, weights proportional to the stated odds divided evenly across the cards of the replacing sheet and rarity, scaled to integers; the land slot's foil share is a separate variant. MTGJSON publishes no booster configuration for TRK yet. Stardates cards (set SDS) carry identifiers derived from the set code and collector number, not MTGJSON's. Replace with MTGJSON's configuration when it appears.
